investigation_notes.Description: An anomalous spike in SharePoint file downloads was observed where the user downloaded 250 files from the corporate SharePoint site compared to their 24-hour baseline of 20. The activity originated from an ISP-assigned IP in Vilnius targeting Microsoft SharePoint Online, and the downloaded files and paths are consistent with logistics and procurement documents tied to the user's Supply Chain & Logistics role. Given the clean IP reputation, Microsoft-hosted destination, matching geolocation and role-appropriate file names, this activity is most consistent with authorized bulk retrieval rather than malicious exfiltration and is classified as Low Priority.
